title: CACTUS
bigQuestion: How does a cactus save water?
paragraphs: A cactus lives where rain is rare. Wide roots quickly collect water near the surface. Its thick stem stores water after storms. A waxy skin slows water loss. Spines give shade and protect the stem. Together, these features help the cactus survive long dry times.
